question:
Two coaxial circular loops of radii $r_1$ and $r_2$ $(r_1\ll r_2)$ lie in the same plane. A steady current $I$ flows in the outer loop for a long time. At $t=0$, the current in the outer loop is brought to zero (by any method). The inner loop has total resistance $R$ (its self-inductance may be nonzero).

Find the total charge $q$ that passes through any cross-section of the inner loop during the entire transient.
